title: Fix Studio metadata admin translations
body:
## Summary
- Localize Studio metadata-admin form controls, validation messages, widgets, embedded editors, and JSON editor fallbacks
- Localize Packages page, create dialog, detail sheet, package scope selector, and missing topbar/sidebar keys
- Keep machine identifiers and protocol values visible as identifiers while localizing user-facing labels

## Verification
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n build
- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell... build
- Browser verified Flow creation form, Packages page/detail, and no fresh missing-translation warnings
